title: Diploma in Quantity surveying and Construction Management (Level 6)
description: Develop essential knowledge and practical skills in cost management, measurement, estimation, and construction project surveying.
longDescription: The Diploma in Quantity Surveying and Construction Management (Level 6) provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of quantity surveying principles and construction cost management. It covers construction measurement, estimating, tendering, procurement, contracts, and project cost control. Learners develop practical skills in preparing bills of quantities, valuations, and financial reports for construction projects.The Diploma in Quantity Surveying provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of quantity surveying principles and construction cost management. It covers construction measurement, estimating, tendering, procurement, contracts, and project cost control. Learners develop practical skills in preparing bills of quantities, valuations, and financial reports for construction projects. This programme is delivered by one of GSS’s academic partners.

modules.title: Elements Of Properly Law And Planning Law

outcomes: Explain the fundamental principles and practices of quantity surveying within the construction industry.
Apply appropriate methods for measuring construction works and preparing bills of quantities.
Prepare accurate cost estimates, budgets, valuations, and financial reports for construction projects.
Evaluate procurement methods, tendering processes, and construction contracts.
Analyse project costs, risks, and financial performance to support effective cost control.
Apply digital technologies and sustainable practices to improve quantity surveying and construction project management.
